key_provisions_or_claims: Digital rights derive from existing fundamental rights; the declaration is political and does not affect legal rights.
Principles and rights overlap and should be clearer; practical meaning needs promotion.
Add principles on innovation, intellectual property and freedom to conduct business.
Monitor via Path to the Digital Decade indicators and feed the State of the Digital Decade report into the European Semester.
Promote the declaration internationally through trade, diplomacy and cooperation.
annotation.summary_en: EESC opinion on the Commission's proposed European Declaration on Digital Rights and Principles for the Digital Decade. It supports a non-binding political declaration grounded in existing fundamental rights, asks for clearer principles, adds innovation, IP and business freedom, and urges monitoring via the Path to the Digital Decade and international promotion.
